gaps.sentence: Never before ___ the committee reached a decision so quickly.
gaps.explanation: 'Never before has the committee reached …' — inversion with present perfect.

gaps.sentence: Not only ___ the tickets expensive, but they were also sold out.
gaps.explanation: Not only were the tickets… — inversion with 'be' needs no auxiliary.

gaps.sentence: Scarcely had the plane taken ___ when the alarm sounded.
gaps.explanation: 'Taken off' completes the phrasal verb inside the inverted 'scarcely had … when' structure.

gaps.sentence: ___ it not been for your help, we would have failed.
gaps.explanation: Had it not been for = if it hadn't been for — fixed inverted conditional.

gaps.sentence: Not since the 1990s ___ unemployment been so low.
gaps.explanation: Not since X has Y happened — present perfect inversion.

gaps.sentence: Only by practising daily ___ you improve your fluency.
gaps.explanation: Only by doing X will you… — future inversion after only by.

gaps.sentence: Scarcely ___ the ink dried before the rumours started.
gaps.explanation: Scarcely had X happened before Y — like hardly… when.

gaps.sentence: Only in an emergency ___ this exit be used.
gaps.explanation: may + be + participle: this exit may be used only in an emergency.
